descriptionMarkdown:
A book full of deconstruction and upgrade planners. For general use or use with Xerol's Grid System book.

# Deconstruction planners
* Everything
* Tiles only
* "Leave Grid" for use with my grid system (leaves all substations, roboports, lamps, and pipes)
* Trees+Rocks only
* Cliffs only
* Trees+Rocks+Cliffs
* Ghosts (unbuilt items and empty module slots, useful for counting how many items you need to bring to finish a build). Also includes items on ground (useful with [Blueprint Shotgun](https://mods.factorio.com/mod/blueprint-shotgun) mod when doing upgrades).

# Upgrade Planners
* Belt upgrades: Converts belts of all colors to the selected color. Downgrading underground belts that are too long will break the connection, so be careful when downgrading.
* Stone to Steel Smelter: Upgrades yellow to red belts and stone to steel smelters, so you can upgrade your entire furnace array in one click.
* Assembler 2 and 3 (upgrades all assemblers).
* Inserter stepwise upgrades (upgrades/downgrades inserters one level at a time).
* Add modules (puts selected level 1 module in all empty slots) - useful for putting prod in labs, or efficiency in miners.

# History/Changelog
## Version 1
Initial upload. Future versions may include additional module tiers and quality options, plus general improvements and incorporating feedback.
